content: Warranty expiry alerts best practice (ITAM/CMMS sources: Invgate, Setyl, Cryotos, AutoSist): alerts must run natively in the tracking system; multi-tier reminders at ~90/60/30/7 days before expiry; weekly digest pattern beats per-event pings (alert fatigue); alerts only as good as registry dates captured at onboarding; tie to criticality rather than uniform escalation. Single-manager internal tools can satisfy this with a dashboard block plus a printable filtered list instead of email infrastructure.
